name: WIZnet W5100
summary: WIZnet W5100 reusable device protocol/configuration support through declared transport contracts.

evidence.scope: Registered protocol/configuration and simulated bus/backend host cases passed in the 241-case native qualification run on macOS arm64. This does not refresh physical evidence.

Historical UNO R4 Minima Ethernet Shield R3 W5100 fixture, before the attached-device refactor. Current throughput and physical acceptance have not been remeasured; see exact observations and exclusions in the report.

limitations: W5100 SPI and MACRAW mode only; W5100S/W5500 support is not implied.
Requires board-owned chip-select/reset and optional shield SD deselection. See exact historical fixture report.
